semiconductor_relevance: High — Enplas Niching Suzhou Co., Ltd specializes in contact solutions essential for semiconductor testing and inspection.
summary: Enplas Niching Suzhou Co., Ltd is a leading provider of contact technology solutions for semiconductor pre-shipment inspection, known for its high-performance resin technology and robust quality assurance. The company offers a comprehensive range of general-purpose IC sockets and specialized test sockets for burn-in and electrical testing, maintaining a significant market share globally.
capabilities: General-purpose IC sockets with ultra-multi pin count and fine pitch
Semiconductor burn-in sockets for thermal acceleration tests
Test sockets for semiconductor electrical testing

regional_presence.China: Enplas Niching Suzhou Co., Ltd operates in Suzhou, focusing on the semiconductor market with a strong emphasis on local manufacturing and development.
